name: codex-auto-retry
description: Monitors quota and safely resumes interrupted Codex tasks from a lightweight Windows tray application.

interface.shortDescription: Monitor quota and recover interrupted Codex tasks.
interface.longDescription: Runs a local, provider-independent watchdog that detects explicit provider failures and silent empty responses, then resumes the same task through official IPC or an optional verified fallback. A Windows tray controller and embedded Codex panel show current quota, live countdowns, bounded controller health, separate per-fault and consecutive no-progress limits, queue state, pause controls, and retry settings.
defaultPrompt: 開啟 CodexWorkResumer 管理面板。
查看自動重試佇列、使用額度與倒數計時。
修改 CodexWorkResumer 的自動恢復設定。
